abilities.desc_zh: 精密弹药
abilities.desc_en: Precision Ammo

abilities.desc_zh: 弹药类型：
abilities.desc_en: Ammo Types:

abilities.title_en: Holding Block at Ranged Distance for <s>0.9</s> {{var_1}} will Swap Autobot Hound’s Ammo Types.
abilities.desc_zh: 在远程距离保持格挡 <s>0.9</s> {{var_1}} 将交换汽车人猎犬的弹药类型。
abilities.desc_en: Holding Block at Ranged Distance for <s>0.9</s> {{var_1}} will Swap Autobot Hound’s Ammo Types.

abilities.title_en: Inferno Ammo grants Critical Ranged Hits a {{var_2}} chance to inflict Burn, dealing {{var_3}} of Attack as Heat damage over {{var_4}}seconds.
abilities.desc_zh: 地狱弹药使致命远程命中有 {{var_2}} 几率造成燃烧，在 {{var_4}} 秒内造成 {{var_3}} 点攻击力热力伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Inferno Ammo grants Critical Ranged Hits a {{var_2}} chance to inflict Burn, dealing {{var_3}} of Attack as Heat damage over {{var_4}}seconds.

abilities.title_en: The third hit of a Ranged Combo has a {{var_5}} chance to refresh the timer of a Burn Debuff.
abilities.desc_zh: 远程连击的第三次命中有 {{var_5}} 几率刷新燃烧减益计时器。
abilities.desc_en: The third hit of a Ranged Combo has a {{var_5}} chance to refresh the timer of a Burn Debuff.

abilities.title_en: Precision Ammo grants Ranged Attacks a {{var_6}} increased Critical Rate and cannot be Evaded and is not affected by abilities that would cause Ranged Attacks to Miss.
abilities.desc_zh: 精确弹药使远程攻击的暴击率提升 {{var_6}}，且无法躲避，并且不受导致远程攻击失手的能力影响。
abilities.desc_en: Precision Ammo grants Ranged Attacks a {{var_6}} increased Critical Rate and cannot be Evaded and is not affected by abilities that would cause Ranged Attacks to Miss.

abilities.title_en: The second hit of a basic ranged combo has a {{var_7}} chance to Nullify a Shield Buff on the opponent.
abilities.desc_zh: 基本远程连击的第二次攻击有 {{var_7}} 几率使对手的护盾增益无效。
abilities.desc_en: The second hit of a basic ranged combo has a {{var_7}} chance to Nullify a Shield Buff on the opponent.

abilities.title_en: The third hit of a basic ranged combo has an {{var_8}} chance to Nullity a Shield Buff on the opponent.
abilities.desc_zh: 基本远程连击的第三次打击有 {{var_8}} 几率使对手的护盾增益无效。
abilities.desc_en: The third hit of a basic ranged combo has an {{var_8}} chance to Nullity a Shield Buff on the opponent.

abilities.title_en: Sidestepping with Precision Ammo Purifies all Daze effects.
abilities.desc_zh: 使用精密弹药进行回避净化了所有眩晕效果。
abilities.desc_en: Sidestepping with Precision Ammo Purifies all Daze effects.

abilities.title_en: Ranged Attacks: Critical Hits on Burning opponents have 50~% Critical Damage.
abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击：对燃烧的对手造成暴击，造成 50% 的暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged Attacks: Critical Hits on Burning opponents have 50~% Critical Damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 重击：
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks:

abilities.title_en: {{var_9}} Chance to gain an Armor Buff, reducing damage from attacks by {{var_10}} for {{var_11}}.
abilities.desc_zh: {{var_9}} 有机会获得装甲增益，减少 {{var_10}} 对 {{var_11}} 攻击造成的伤害。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_9}} Chance to gain an Armor Buff, reducing damage from attacks by {{var_10}} for {{var_11}}.

abilities.title_en: {{var_12}} Chance to inflict a Critical Resistance Debuff, increasing the chance for Critical Hits against opponents by {{var_13}}? for {{var_14}}seconds.
abilities.desc_zh: {{var_12}} 有机会造成致命一击减益，增加 {{var_13}} 对对手致命一击的几率？为 {{var_14}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_12}} Chance to inflict a Critical Resistance Debuff, increasing the chance for Critical Hits against opponents by {{var_13}}? for {{var_14}}seconds.

abilities.desc_zh:
在激烈的交火中，这个强大的机器人利用其惊人的敏捷性来机动并利用敌人的弱点。

回避远程攻击：

当汽车人猎犬翻滚以避免远程攻击时，他会为 {{var_16}} 获得 {{var_15}} 远程奖励。

+{{var_17}} 每级
abilities.desc_en:
Warrior Ballerina
In the heat of a firefight this robust robot uses his surprising agility to maneuver and exploit the enemy's weak points.
Sidestepping Ranged Attacks:
When Autobot Hound rolls to avoid a Ranged Attack he gains a {{var_15}} Ranged Bonus for {{var_16}}.
+{{var_17}} per level

abilities.desc_zh: 大男孩来了！
abilities.desc_en: Rolling Thunder - Big boy coming through!

abilities.desc_zh: 当配备精准弹药时，最后一击有 {{var_18}} 几率对 {{var_20}} 造成 {{var_19}} 暴击率下降。
abilities.desc_en: While Precision Ammo is equipped the last hit has a {{var_18}} Chance to inflict {{var_19}} Critical Rate Down for {{var_20}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 当配备地狱弹药时，最后一击有 {{var_21}} 几率造成燃烧，造成 {{var_22}} 攻击力超过 {{var_23}}。
abilities.desc_en: While Inferno Ammo is equipped this the last hit has a {{var_21}} chance to inflict Burn, dealing {{var_22}} of Attack over {{var_23}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 战斗开始时修复基地生命值的{{var_44}}~{{var_45}}。 +{{var_46}}~{{var_47}} 突袭中的额外修复。

abilities.desc_en: Allies – Optimus Prime MV1, Drift - +{{var_48}}~{{var_49}} Armor.

abilities.desc_en: +{{var_50}} Critical Damage.

abilities.desc_zh:
所有导弹攻击（重击、SP1的最后一击，SP2的所有攻击）命中时有70%几率造成燃烧，施加攻击力80%的伤害，持续4秒。
如果对手正在燃烧中，则燃烧可以叠加，每层依旧是4秒，但伤害为攻击力的30%。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks: Double Missile Attack has +{{var_4}} chance to inflict Burn.

abilities.desc_zh: 重击命中时：70%几率触发流血，造成攻击力45%的伤害，持续5.6秒。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks: 70% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing 45% Attack over 5.6 seconds.
